title: French Kanten Casserole
description: A traditional French dessert made with kanten, a jelly-like substance derived from red algae, for a unique texture and flavor.

ingredients.name: dried fruits (such as cranberries, raisins, and cherries)
roasted nuts (such as almonds or hazelnuts)
deliciously roasted Canadian hazelnut oil or other neutral oil

instructions: Combine kanten and agar in a bowl and mix well.
Add dried fruits, sugar, and water to the bowl and mix until everything is well combined.
Add roasted nuts and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix well.
Pour the mixture into a 20cm x 20cm baking dish and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Cut the casserole into small squares and serve chilled.
Optional: Drizzle with hazelnut oil before serving.
